name: AI Model Comparison
overview: Compare model capability, context limits and deployment options.
practice: Evaluate with representative tasks rather than headline benchmarks.

name: AI API Cost Calculator
overview: Estimate input and output token charges using chosen rates.
practice: Verify provider price tiers and caching assumptions.

name: Prompt Engineering
overview: Structure instructions, examples and output constraints for reliable responses.
practice: Test prompts against edge cases and ambiguous inputs.

name: AI Agents
overview: Understand tool access, orchestration and operational boundaries.
practice: Define permissions, validation and human approvals for actions.

name: Local AI Hardware
overview: Compare GPUs, VRAM, system memory and workload fit.
practice: Confirm model quantization and power requirements.

name: GPU Cloud Pricing
overview: Evaluate rented accelerator cost versus usage intensity.
practice: Include storage, data transfer and idle time.

name: AI Safety & Privacy
overview: Understand data handling, prompt injection and output risks.
practice: Apply least privilege and never paste production secrets.

name: Open Source AI
overview: Explore licensing, deployment trade-offs and model updates.
practice: Check license terms before redistribution or commercial use.

name: Programming Tools
overview: Explore editors, debuggers and workflows for maintainable code.
practice: Choose tools based on stack compatibility and support.

name: API Testing
overview: Plan request validation, authentication and error-case coverage.
practice: Test retries, timeouts and malformed requests.

name: JSON Tools
overview: Inspect, validate and format structured JSON data.
practice: Avoid pasting credentials into third-party services.

name: Regex & Text Utilities
overview: Understand reliable text matching and replacement.
practice: Test Unicode and performance on large inputs.

name: PDF Utilities
overview: Learn document merge, split, compression and metadata tasks.
practice: Consider privacy before uploading confidential files.

name: Image Utilities
overview: Plan image dimensions, compression and format conversion.
practice: Retain originals and check transparency handling.

name: Domain & DNS
overview: Understand record types, propagation and verification.
practice: Validate authoritative records and SSL configuration.

name: Cloud Hosting
overview: Compare static hosting, serverless functions and managed compute.
practice: Estimate egress, build limits and operational needs.

name: Cybersecurity Basics
overview: Learn defensive principles across endpoints, accounts and web apps.
practice: Prioritize updates, MFA and backup recovery.

name: Password Security
overview: Understand password managers, passkeys and authentication.
practice: Never use actual passwords in online strength demos.

name: Privacy Protection
overview: Review tracker blocking, consent and data minimization.
practice: Separate legal requirements from optional privacy features.

name: Website Performance
overview: Measure web vital metrics and delivery bottlenecks.
practice: Test real mobile connections and representative devices.

name: YouTube SEO
overview: Plan searchable titles, descriptions and video metadata.
practice: Track retention and click-through rather than keyword counts alone.

name: Video Creator Tools
overview: Understand aspect ratios, cuts, captions and encoding.
practice: Choose export settings according to the target platform.

name: Thumbnail Planning
overview: Learn composition, contrast and title-image alignment.
practice: Run controlled creative tests instead of relying on guesses.

name: Social Media Analytics
overview: Interpret reach, engagement, conversion and audience metrics.
practice: Compare consistent time periods and attribution assumptions.

name: Content Calendar
overview: Plan publishing across channels and campaign goals.
practice: Balance production capacity with useful content demand.

name: Robotics
overview: Understand sensors, actuators, controllers and safety.
practice: Compare tasks and environments before selecting hardware.

name: Drones
overview: Explore flight time, payload, use cases and legal restrictions.
practice: Check airspace rules before flight.

name: IoT & Microcontrollers
overview: Understand connected sensors, firmware and device protocols.
practice: Plan power, update security and network reliability.

name: 3D Printing
overview: Compare materials, printer types and slicing settings.
practice: Consider tolerances, ventilation and part strength.

name: Technology News
overview: Follow AI, semiconductor and software developments.
practice: Read primary release notes and separate announcements from availability.
